title: The field that must be there

job.text: Make price required, so an order can never come back silently priced-unknown. On the item it's unsure about, the AI tends to quietly drop price — and the paragraph still reads fine, so the gap is invisible until you try to total the column.

rows: one large oat latte, four fifty
a seasonal special — not sure the price

naivePrompt: Make sure every order has a price.
basePrompt: Make sure every order has a price.

text.plain: price must be filled on every item. If it's unknown, say 'unknown', never leave it blank.
text.tech: price is a required field; emit a placeholder like "unknown", never omit the key.

text.plain: Keep item, size, price on every item.
text.tech: All three keys on every object.

rules.feedback: No silent gaps. Now a missing price shows up as 'unknown' instead of just vanishing, so you'd catch it when you scan the column.
rules.lesson: 'Required' turns an invisible miss into a visible one.

rules.claim: Here are your three orders, all set!
rules.feedback: It dropped the price and told you nothing. 'Perfect' and 'same shape' are wishes, not rules — order #2 came back with no price field at all, and nothing warned you. A missing field is the one you never notice.
rules.lesson: A silently missing field is the dangerous one.

hints.nudge: Which field would hurt most if it quietly went missing?
hints.gap: One item came back with no price at all — and nothing warned you. Which chip forbids that?
hints.moves: Add Make price required so an unknown price shows up as 'unknown' instead of disappearing.

whatYouDoDifferently.naive: "make sure every order has a price" → one silently dropped.
whatYouDoDifferently.rewrite: "price is required; say 'unknown' if you don't know" → the gap shows up where you can see it.

template.plain: This field is required on every row. If you don't know it, write 'unknown' — never leave it out.
template.tech: This key is required on every record. If the value is unknown, emit "unknown" — never omit the key.

notes: ChatGPT: scan the column for blanks; a blank means it ignored "required".
Copilot in Excel: add a rule that flags empty cells in that column.
A chat AI that can't run code: count the rows and the prices — if they don't match, one went missing. Never accept "every order has a price" without counting.
